decode_names() allocates the output buffer and keeps ownership of it (freed later by free_context()).
The owned buffer is handed to the codec as the caller-supplied output buffer; on codec failure ownership is not transferred.

err path frees only the internal tmp buffer (out_free is NULL because out was caller-supplied), so no one is told the buffer was already freed; the dangling pointer stays in ctx->desc[0].buf.
uncompress() returned -1, so decode_names() takes the error path and calls free_context() for cleanup.
Error cleanup walks all descriptors and frees every ctx->desc[i].buf, including the buffer already freed by rle_decode().
